aspect: The adjustment happens before you speak
description: It is triggered by appearance or a name on a screen, which is how the target knows it is not about comprehension.
energy_note: Decided before you opened your mouth.

aspect: Your own field, explained to you
description: Being told how your specialism works by somebody outside it, in simplified terms, in front of people who know you are the specialist.
energy_note: Lectured on the thing you are the expert in.

description: Saying 'I know, I wrote the protocol' is accurate and lands as boasting. Absorbing it costs credibility with everyone watching.
energy_note: Correct and insufferable, or silent and diminished.

description: The contractor addresses every technical answer to her junior male colleague, who relays each one back to her. This continues for two hours. Afterwards the colleague says he did not notice.
energy_note: Two hours of being translated to by your own junior.
